name: nrf52840
description: Nordic nRF52840 (Cortex-M4F 64 MHz, 1 MB flash, 256 KB RAM, BLE/802.15.4 radio, USB, QSPI): GNU Arm toolchain with the nrfx drivers and MDK (from the nRF Connect SDK or the nrfx repository), Renode nRF52840 models

toolchain.notes: Bare-metal programs use the start-up in tools/nrf52/glue (vector table; interrupts go to the nrfx handler names such as nrfx_saadc_irq_handler, shared serial instances are dispatched by ENABLE). Add nrfx driver sources (${NRFX}/drivers/src/nrfx_<x>.c) as needed; the glue's nrfx_config.h enables all drivers. NRFX_LOG_* prints on UARTE1. Zephyr/NCS builds for nrf52840dk_nrf52840 also run (load zephyr.elf).

image.notes: load the ELF. Programs built for a SoftDevice or the Adafruit UF2 bootloader start at 0x1000/0x26000 and need their bootloader/SoftDevice image loaded too; prefer an application built without one (start at 0x0).

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/nordic/nrf52840dk_nrf52840.repl, platforms/boards/nordic/nrf52840_supermini.repl (LED P0.15). Serial instances twi0, twi1, spi2, spi3 are SPI/SPIM/SPIS/TWI/TWIM/TWIS by ENABLE; attach I2C devices with 'Sensors.X @ twi0 0x6A', one SPI device per instance. Analog: 'saadc SetInputVoltage <ain> <V>', 'comp SetInputVoltage <ain> <V>', or wire a GPIO output with 'gpio0: 31 -> saadc@1'. 'temp Temperature 30', 'qdec Rotate 10', 'clock VbusPresent true', 'clock SupplyVoltage 1.8'. Pins: add 'pins: Miscellaneous.PinRecorder @ gpio0 0' with connections 'gpio0:' / '    13 -> pins@13' (a .repl file), then 'sysbus.gpio0.pins Edges 13'; 'pwm0 Duty <ch>'. Jumpers of the nrfx samples: 'uart1 EnableLoopback', 'twi1 Loopback true', 'twi0 LinkTarget twi1'. QSPI flash is qspi_flash (MappedMemory at 0x12000000). Docs: tools/nrf52/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the nrfx samples (tools/nrf52/run_samples.py with samples_nrf52840.txt in the Renode tree)
